subject: Genetics
title: Gene Flow
description: Learn Gene Flow in one minute.

hook.text: A bird flies to a new island and mates with the local population. Its genes mix in. That's gene flow.

buildup.text: Gene flow is the movement of alleles between populations through migration. It homogenizes—making groups more similar.

discovery.text: Before modern travel, human gene flow was slow. Mountains, oceans, and deserts kept populations genetically distinct.

twist.text: Gene flow can counteract natural selection.

climax.text: Today, global human gene flow is the highest in history. We're becoming more genetically similar, not less.

punchline.text: Migration mixes genes. The world is blending.

quiz.question: What effect does gene flow have on populations?
